description: 경상북도 영주시_연도별 하수슬러지 발생 및 처리량 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상북도 영주시. 본 API는 영주시에서 연도별·월별로 발생한 하수슬러지의 양과 이에 대한 처리량, 탈수케이크량(슬러지를 탈수한 고형물의 양) 등 주요 환경 데이터를 제공하는 서비스입니다. Coverage: 경상북도 영주시. The portal files it under the publisher 경상북도 영주시. Its tags are 하수슬러지처리, 오염물질발생현황, 물환경관리, 환경통계, 하수처리시설운영. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
